parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 6 achieved val_bpb 0.8764. This suggests the model has capacity for more layers. Now I'll investigate if reducing the batch size further (to 262144) allows for more optimizer steps, potentially squeezing out even more performance given the depth increase.
parsed.description: Increase DEPTH to 6 to scale capacity and reduce TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute budget, building on the recent success of depth scaling.
